headline: Bitcoin slid to an 11-week low after a strong US jobs report raised December rate-hike bets, and it missed the bounce in tech stocks.

market.asOf: From CoinMarketCap, read about 19:56 UTC Fri 6 Nov (CoinGecko could not be reached this run). The 24h change for BTC and ETH was shown without a sign, so it is left out. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Fear: CoinMarketCap's Crypto Fear & Greed Index read 31 at about 19:56 UTC.

stories.title: Bitcoin hits an 11-week low and misses the stock bounce after hot jobs data
stories.summary: The US added far more jobs in October than expected, which raised the odds that the Fed raises interest rates in December. Tech stocks bounced after Thursday's rout, but bitcoin kept sliding to its lowest price since 21 August.
points: Payrolls rose 165,000 against a 65,000 average forecast, and unemployment fell to 4.1% from an expected 4.2%, per CoinDesk.
Bitcoin fell to $74,762 after the start of the US session, its lowest since 21 August, per Cointelegraph; Decrypt put the low at $74,780.91.
Odds of a 25bp December Fed hike rose from 66.9% to 76.8% per CME FedWatch (via Cointelegraph); CoinDesk reported 77%.
Around 2pm ET the Nasdaq was up 1.42% and the S&P 500 up 0.72%, while bitcoin was down 0.75% on the day, per Yahoo Finance (intraday, not the close).
About $1.05B of leveraged bets were forcibly closed in 24 hours, $930M of them bets on rising prices, per Decrypt.

sources.label: Yahoo Finance: stock market today, 6 Nov

stories.title: Big investors keep pulling money out of crypto funds
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds (ETFs) lost $430M on Thursday, led by Fidelity and BlackRock. ETFs are the main way big US investors buy bitcoin, so steady withdrawals remove one of the market's biggest buyers. Friday's figures are not out yet.
points: Net outflow of $430.2M on 5 Nov, with Fidelity's FBTC at $199.9M and BlackRock's IBIT at $105M, per CoinDesk.
Bitcoin ETF withdrawals reached $869.8M over November's first four trading days, per CoinDesk.
Across all US spot crypto ETFs, outflows topped $540M on the day, per The Block.
BlackRock's IBIT alone has lost $806.5M in November, per CoinCentral.

sources.label: CoinDesk: ETFs shed $430M after tech rout
The Block: crypto ETFs see over $500M outflows

stories.title: Binance hack: $3.1B still in hacker wallets as withdrawals reopen
stories.summary: Blockchain analysts at Elliptic say the hackers behind the Binance theft are slowly converting stolen coins into bitcoin, but little has been cashed out. Binance says it has replaced virtually all stolen assets and plans to reopen more withdrawals by the end of next week.
points: About $3.11B sits in addresses linked to the theft and $2.85B has been frozen or seized, per Elliptic's 6 Nov update.
About 1,650 BTC (about $124M) has been converted from other stolen assets, across more than 20,000 wallets on 16 blockchains, per Elliptic.
The Block puts the total breach at $6.43B and says Binance aims to reopen HYPE, INJ, APT, PLASMA, NEAR and LTC withdrawals by the end of next week.
Elliptic says nothing it has seen shows an AI agent making laundering decisions, per The Block.

briefs.title: CFTC tells prediction markets to serve all states
briefs.summary: The CFTC gave exchanges such as Kalshi and Polymarket 30 days to reopen blocked states or explain why that is not feasible, clashing with recent court rulings, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: US sanctions 45 more Prince Group targets
briefs.summary: The Treasury designated 4 individuals and 41 entities tied to the alleged crypto-scam network; the US is seeking forfeiture of about $14B in bitcoin linked to it, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Crypto-in-401(k) rule moves to White House review
briefs.summary: The Labor Department sent a proposed rule on alternative assets, including crypto, in 401(k) plans to the White House budget office for review, per The Block.

briefs.title: Trump Media moves 4,259 BTC to Crypto.com
briefs.summary: Coins from addresses labelled as collateral for its 2028 convertible notes went to Crypto.com; note holders can demand repayment on 30 Nov, per CoinDesk. The company did not reply.

briefs.title: Coinbase stock drops after Morgan Stanley downgrade
briefs.summary: COIN closed at $136.82 on Thursday, down 9.69%, after Morgan Stanley cut its target to $120 from $258, per MoneyCheck.

briefs.title: Strive posts $509M profit from bitcoin gains
briefs.summary: Strive bought 15,124 BTC in October and now holds 43,124 BTC; its Q3 profit came from unrealized bitcoin gains, per The Block.

briefs.title: Thailand moves to block Bitget
briefs.summary: Thailand's SEC filed a criminal complaint saying Bitget offered crypto trading in Thailand without a license from 2022 to 2025, and plans to block it from 5 Dec, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Gnosis Pay customer data accessed
briefs.summary: The crypto card provider says hackers got into a legacy card system, detected on 3 Nov; customer funds were not affected and users should watch for phishing, per Decrypt.

calendar.event: US CPI inflation (Oct); Bitdeer results call 8:00am ET (20:00 Bangkok)
calendar.note: Expected: +0.3% on the month and core +0.2%, per Economic Weekly. September: +0.6% headline and +0.3% core on the month, per BLS. BLS will not publish yearly rates where October 2025 data are missing. CoreWeave call 5:00pm ET.

MSCI says shortly after 11:00pm Central European Time; changes take effect at the close on 30 Nov. MSCI previously named Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi as possible exclusions, per DL News. Veterans Day: the stock market is open, per Economic Weekly.

calendar.event: US weekly jobless claims; Bit Digital results call 8:30am ET; Fed's Barr 10:00am ET (22:00 Bangkok)
calendar.note: Claims expected 193K, prior 189K, per Economic Weekly. Cleveland Fed's Hammack also speaks at 8:30am ET. Gemini reports results after the US close.

calendar.event: Deribit weekly bitcoin and ether options expiry
calendar.note: Deribit options expire at 08:00 UTC, per CryptoTicker; its 4 Nov data showed more puts (10,213 BTC) than calls (7,889 BTC) open for 13 Nov.

calendar.event: US producer prices (PPI, Oct); Gemini results call 8:30am ET
calendar.note: Expected: +0.3% headline and core on the month, per Economic Weekly. September: +1.3% on the month and 6.3% on the year, per BLS.
The Fed held at 3.75-4.00% on 28 Oct in a 10-2 vote. After the jobs report, odds of a 25bp hike were 77.7% per CME FedWatch (via KuCoin/BlockBeats).
